Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the private VPC flow looks promising for us. We need to run a 6–8 week POC inside our AWS account to validate network isolation, KMS integration, and log export to our SIEM.

Two asks from our side to make the POC viable:
- Trial credits applied to our account (estimate: ~$4k) so we can exercise realistic traffic.
- A short extension to the standard trial period to allow the security review to complete.

We're ready to share our SOC2 summary and the security questionnaire (attached) — would Redwood consider conditioning the credits on the successful review of those artifacts? Procurement is copied to coordinate paperwork and an NDA if you need one.

Daniel — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the questionnaire. Appreciate the detail.

Short answer: we can support a private/VPC POC and we typically approve promotional credits for security-led evaluations when documentation is provided. Proposed approach:
- Provisional $4,000 credit applied to a scoped project for up to 60 days.
- Credits are conditional: receipt of SOC2 summary or equivalent + completed security questionnaire + signed DPA/NDA.
- We will enable a private VPC integration checklist (KMS, VPC peering, S3 log delivery) and a runbook for onboarding.

Can you confirm the AWS account ID and whether you need Redwood-managed KMS keys or will bring your own? I attached a short POC runbook template that we use for these engagements. Once I have those pieces I'll start the internal approval flow.

Attachment: POC-runbook-template.docx
